text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kokura Kinen is here. The race has many favorable conditions for Nice Nature, such as its distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, it is precisely because of these perfect conditions that Nice Nature feels even more pressure not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature walks nervously into the paddock as the cheers of the people from the Kokura shopping district shower down on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing their voices, she switches up her attitude and heads off to the race, determined to meet their expectations.
